miscompile_bugs.bug: FreshConnection.respond_to?(:connection_manager) returns false under Spinel despite the method being defined in the same entrypoint file via `class << self`, indicating Spinel miscompiles respond_to? for singleton-class methods on a Module.

Spinel returns false for `Object.new.respond_to?(:require_relative, true)` where CRuby returns true, indicating Spinel does not recognise the built-in Kernel#require_relative as a private instance method when queried via respond_to? with include_all=true.
Spinel incorrectly returns false for Module#respond_to? when the method is defined via `class << self` (singleton class extension), whereas CRuby correctly returns true.

Spinel returns 0 for attr_reader :lat/:lng on Loc::Location instances initialized via new(lat, lng), indicating instance variable assignment in initialize is not reflected by the generated reader methods.
Spinel returns Integer instead of Module for Rack::Authenticate.class, miscompiling a Module#class call on a plain module constant as if it were an integer literal.

miscompile_bugs.bug: Spinel fails to resolve `class << self` singleton methods on a module (encode, decode, decode_center) even when defined in the directly inlined source file, emitting 0 at compile time and crashing at runtime with "undefined method 'encode' for class".
Spinel evaluates `defined?(Hrk)` as nil/empty string instead of "constant" for a module that is correctly defined and accessible via other means (is_a?(Module) and .name both work).

Spinel miscompiles the block-parameter `attempt_number` threaded through `Enumerable#inject` in `RetryThis#retry_this`: the block argument received inside the user block is `0` (Spinel) instead of the correct integer `1` (CRuby) on the first attempt, indicating inject/yield propagation of loop variables is broken.

Spinel miscompiles String#gsub with a regex block that uses $1 (last-match capture global) — the block body returns an empty string instead of the expected incremented integer string, so bump_version("1.0.0") produces "" instead of "1.0.1".

Spinel incorrectly reports `Singem::VERSION.frozen?` as `true` when CRuby returns `false`, indicating Spinel wrongly freezes string literals assigned to module constants without a frozen_string_literal magic comment.
File.read with a __FILE__-relative path inside a required file returns an empty string under Spinel instead of the file contents, causing TVDinner::Ssh::VERSION to be blank rather than "0.0.14".
String#end_with? returns false in Spinel when called on a path string constructed via File.join/File.dirname that ends with the expected suffix, but returns true in CRuby.

Spinel emits `0` instead of `true` for a boolean `attr_accessor` field aliased with `alias_method :ok?, :ok` and assigned `true` inside a Ragel-generated `tap` block — `TicketValidate#ok?` returns `0` (falsy integer) instead of `true`.
Spinel miscompiles String#length on an interpolated string containing ANSI escape sequences, returning 0 instead of the correct character count (14 for "\e[32mhello\e[0m").

miscompile_bugs.bug: Spinel's Hash#each block yields raw object IDs (or pointer values) instead of the actual key/value strings when iterating with |k,v| destructuring inside a module-included instance method, causing attrs_to_s to produce numeric garbage instead of formatted attribute strings.
Spinel returns the wrong value for symbol-keyed hash constant lookup: `Satoshi::UNIT_DENOMINATIONS[:btc]` evaluates to 0 (the :satoshi value) instead of 8 under Spinel AOT compilation.

Spinel's Module#instance_methods returns private methods in the result even though Ruby's instance_methods should only include public and protected methods, causing the returned array to include all 13 methods instead of the correct 5 public/accessor methods.

Spinel prints `1` instead of `true` when `puts` is called on the return value of a proc that returns the literal `true`, indicating a miscompile in boolean-to-string conversion for proc/block return values.
Spinel miscompiles String#delete (called inside Timecapsule.delete_commas via value.delete(',')), returning a numeric value instead of the comma-stripped string.
Spinel incorrectly reports a module-level String constant (Gitfinger::VERSION) as frozen, returning true for .frozen? where CRuby returns false.

miscompile_bugs.bug: Spinel mis-types the PRODUCT_TYPE_IDENTIFIER Hash constant as int, causing all string-keyed [] lookups to emit 0 instead of the expected string values (warning: cannot resolve call to '[]' on int).

Spinel ignores the `class << self` `to_s` override defined on a module, so `FrostyMeadow::Version.to_s` returns the default Module#to_s ("FrostyMeadow::Version") instead of the overridden value ("2.3.1").

Spinel miscompiles the return value of a proc-based mock Rack app: the integer status 200 from the proc is replaced with a garbage pointer value (203875506144704), and the localizer confirms `env` is typed as i:0 instead of h:{} at the call site.
Spinel reports `SeapigServer.constants.empty?` as false when the module declares no constants, whereas CRuby correctly returns true — Spinel incorrectly populates constants on a bare empty module.
